acceptanceCriteria: a run killed at the per-run limit reports a detail that names the timeout and the limit
a regression test pins the detail; a mutation that drops it fails the test
body: Found by the V1-0547 spike (PR #963, head a8d56d3be, 2026-10-16). When the mutation runner kills a run at its per-run limit, the witness detail reads `run ended without a verdict` (the V1-0651 generic form). Expected: a detail naming the per-run timeout and its limit, so the operator can tell a timeout from a sandbox denial or a crash. Reproduction: the V1-0547 test at a 5 m wall time on a loaded host (lane log agent-spikes/0547-mut-5m-default.log under the session scratchpad). Related: V1-0651 (completed; named sandbox-exec denials), V1-0547.
title: mutate: a per-run timeout kill is reported as "run ended without a verdict" instead of naming the timeout
